clauses.clause: 120 metered A100 hours is a planning target, not the hard limit of the study.
150 metered A100 hours is the overall ceiling. Work stops at that total.
the 8-hour Step 1 allocation is a checkpoint, not a hard cap. Reaching it requires a report and a decision, not an automatic stop.
Step 1 may run independent workers concurrently, one model on one A100 per worker. Tensor parallelism stays forbidden and tensor_parallel_size stays 1.
concurrency shortens the calendar and never the budget. Metered A100 hours are summed over workers, so two concurrent single-A100 workers cost the same total as one worker running twice as long.

freeze_change_rule: the sealed freeze is never edited. A change to a design field would require a new freeze directory, not this amendment.
scope: execution budget and worker layout only
unchanged_by_this_amendment: every sample frame, item id, and dataset revision
every prompt template, response grammar, and parser rule
every model and tokenizer revision, and the vllm==0.28.0 engine pin
every serving field: max_model_len 8192, bfloat16, tensor_parallel_size 1, gpu_memory_utilization 0.9, max_num_seqs 64, greedy decoding
every screen criterion, threshold, floor, estimand, test, and claim gate
the discovery and confirmation separation, and the replacement and fallback policies
